content.text: /ext:medcp In children 5-17 with asthma, do monthly ED visits for exacerbation and oral steroid bursts show fall and spring peaks over the last three years?
I’ll pull monthly counts for ages 5–17 over the last 36 complete months, using OMOP asthma/ED/drug concepts, then compare spring/fall months against the rest.

arguments.sql_query: SELECT MIN(visit_start_date) AS min_visit_date, MAX(visit_start_date) AS max_visit_date, COUNT(*) AS n_visits FROM omop.visit_occurrence

SELECT TOP 20 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept FROM omop.concept WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%asthma%' AND domain_id='Condition' ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept='S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_id

SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Visit' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%emergency%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ed%') ORDER BY concept_id

SELECT TOP 50 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept, domain_id FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%prednisone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%prednisolone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%dexamethasone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%methylprednisolone%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept='S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name

arguments.sql_query: SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Route' AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%oral%' ORDER BY concept_id

WITH params AS (
  SELECT CAST('2023-07-01' AS date) AS start_date, CAST('2026-07-01' AS date) AS end_date
), asthma_dx AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 317009
), exacerbation_dx AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id
  FROM omop.concept c
  JOIN asthma_dx a ON a.concept_id = c.concept_id
  WHERE c.domain_id='Condition'
    AND c.standard_concept='S'
    AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%exacerb%' OR c.concept_id = 257581)
), steroid_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1518254,1506270,1550557,1551099)
), asthma_persons AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN asthma_dx a ON co.condition_concept_id = a.concept_id
), ed_exacerb AS (
  SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(v.visit_start_date), MONTH(v.visit_start_date), 1) AS month_start,
         COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_occurrence_id) AS ed_exacerbation_visits
  FROM omop.visit_occurrence v
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id
  JOIN exacerbation_dx ex ON ex.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = v.person_id
  CROSS JOIN params pr
  WHERE v.visit_start_date >= pr.start_date AND v.visit_start_date < pr.end_date
    AND v.visit_concept_id IN (9203, 262, 8870, 581381, 38004220, 600074763)
    AND DATEDIFF(year, p.birth_datetime, v.visit_start_date) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(year, DATEDIFF(year, p.birth_datetime, v.visit_start_date), p.birth_datetime) > v.visit_start_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END BETWEEN 5 AND 17
  GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(v.visit_start_date), MONTH(v.visit_start_date), 1)
), steroid_bursts AS (
  SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date), MONTH(de.drug_exposure_start_date), 1) AS month_start,
         COUNT(DISTINCT de.drug_exposure_id) AS oral_steroid_bursts
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN steroid_drugs sd ON sd.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  JOIN asthma_persons ap ON ap.person_id = de.person_id
  JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = de.person_id
  CROSS JOIN params pr
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date >= pr.start_date AND de.drug_exposure_start_date < pr.end_date
    AND (de.route_concept_id = 4132161 OR LOWER(de.drug_source_value) LIKE '%oral%' OR LOWER(de.drug_source_value) LIKE '% po %')
    AND (de.days_supply IS NULL OR de.days_supply BETWEEN 1 AND 14)
    AND DATEDIFF(year, p.birth_datetime, de.drug_exposure_start_date) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(year, DATEDIFF(year, p.birth_datetime, de.drug_exposure_start_date), p.birth_datetime) > de.drug_exposure_start_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END BETWEEN 5 AND 17
  GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date), MONTH(de.drug_exposure_start_date), 1)
), months AS (
  SELECT CAST('2023-07-01' AS date) AS month_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATEADD(month,1,month_start) FROM months WHERE month_start < '2026-06-01'
)
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(7), m.month_start, 120) AS month,
       COALESCE(e.ed_exacerbation_visits,0) AS ed_exacerbation_visits,
       COALESCE(s.oral_steroid_bursts,0) AS oral_steroid_bursts,
       CASE WHEN MONTH(m.month_start) IN (3,4,5) THEN 'spring'
            WHEN MONTH(m.month_start) IN (9,10,11) THEN 'fall'
            WHEN MONTH(m.month_start) IN (12,1,2) THEN 'winter'
            ELSE 'summer' END AS season
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN ed_exacerb e ON e.month_start = m.month_start
LEFT JOIN steroid_bursts s ON s.month_start = m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);

Best interpretation: under the strict definitions used, no fall/spring peaks are detectable; a reliable answer needs either pre-indexed cohort tables or locally optimized extraction of:
1. pediatric asthma cohort,
2. ED encounters,
3. exacerbation diagnosis/source codes,
4. oral prednisone/prednisolone/dexamethasone/methylprednisolone bursts.
